title.es: Aquel en el que Fina deja la casa grande
title.en: The One Where Fina Leaves the Big House

description.es: Fina se despide de la casa grande y, al salir, se encuentra con Damián. Ella le agradece la hospitalidad y él le recuerda que esa fue la casa donde creció. Damián le promete guardar su secreto y se disculpa por no haber podido protegerla de Pelayo. Finalmente, Fina le agradece que la haya aceptado tal como es y ambos comparten un abrazo.
description.en: Fina says goodbye to the big house and, on her way out, runs into Damián. She thanks him for his hospitality, and he reminds her that this was the house where she grew up. Damián promises to keep her secret and apologizes for not having been able to protect her from Pelayo. Finally, Fina thanks him for having accepted her just as she is, and the two share an embrace.
